case.believed: OutputPass snapshots WebGLRenderer tone mapping and exposure when constructed, so changing renderer settings later requires recreating the pass or manually changing its material uniforms and defines.
contract: OutputPass reads the current WebGLRenderer toneMappingExposure on every render and updates its uniform without rebuilding the shader program.
Changing WebGLRenderer.toneMapping after OutputPass construction rebuilds the pass defines on the next render, replacing ACES_FILMIC_TONE_MAPPING with NEUTRAL_TONE_MAPPING.
Changing WebGLRenderer.outputColorSpace after construction rebuilds the pass defines and removes SRGB_TRANSFER for LinearSRGBColorSpace.
OutputPass binds the current readBuffer texture on every render and completes a real WebGL 2 draw in offline Chrome 134.
case.goal: Prove how three.js 0.185.1 OutputPass follows live WebGLRenderer tone-mapping exposure, algorithm, and output color-space changes in a real pinned browser.
